import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    pattern = s
    ans = 0
    for i in range(0, 100000000, 25):
        test = str(i)
        if len(test) != len(pattern):
            continue
        digits = test
        x_digit = None
        works = True
        for j in range(len(pattern)):
            if pattern[j] == 'X':
                if x_digit is None:
                    x_digit = digits[j]
                elif digits[j] != x_digit:
                    works = False
                    break
            elif pattern[j] != '_':
                if digits[j] != pattern[j]:
                    works = False
                    break
        if works:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
